My two best friends, one is a poet and the other is a deaf person, work at the same firm but in different positions of the corporate ladder. The poet is the COO and the deaf person has been working there on and off after getting fired from her last job. Who has a high-ranking position at the firm?
A. The poet
B. Unknown
C. The deaf person
